# v3-jsoneditor

> Vue 3 JSON editor component wrapping jsoneditor v10. It offers v-model (any JSON), tree/code/form/text/view modes, light/dark/auto/classic themes via --vje-* CSS variables, accessible full screen, JSON Schema validation, SSR-safe loading and TypeScript types.

Install: `npm install v3-jsoneditor`

```vue
<script setup>
import { ref } from 'vue'
import Vue3Jsoneditor from 'v3-jsoneditor'
const json = ref({ hello: 'vue' })
</script>
<template>
  <Vue3Jsoneditor v-model="json" v-model:currentMode="mode" theme="auto" height="400px" :options="{ schema }" />
</template>
```

Key facts:
- Props: modelValue, text, options, currentMode ('code'), modeList, theme ('light'), height ('400px'), plus (true), fullscreen, readOnly, debounce, language ('en'), indentation (2), mainMenuBar, navigationBar, statusBar.
- Events: update:modelValue, update:text, update:currentMode, update:fullscreen, change, error, validation-error, mode-change, fullscreen-change, focus, blur, textSelectionChange, selectionChange, colorPicker.
- Ref methods: getEditor(), get(), getText(), validate(), focus(), setEditorContent(json), expandAll(), collapseAll(), toggleFullScreen().
- Slots: #toolbar="{ editor, mode }", default (placeholder before mount).
- Global defaults: app.use(Vue3Jsoneditor, { componentName, theme, height, options, ... }).
- `options` is passed to jsoneditor. Your callbacks run in addition to the component's.
